title: Concept: Vert.x JSON decode error echoing the payload
description: A Vert.x decode exception that repeats the offending input in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message quotes the fragment that failed to parse, so malformed input can be used to probe how the body is parsed and where it is stored.
applicability: Deployments that render a Vert.x decode exception that repeats the offending input into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message quotes the fragment that failed to parse, so malformed input can be used to probe how the body is parsed and where it is stored.
